iterations.label: baseline
iterations.reason: Establish the unmodified behaviour through the real frontend.

iterations.label: CTA plan + label guidance
iterations.failure: Post ended 'Hiring for more engineers' while the audience was hiring managers - the author's intent inverted.
iterations.change: build_plan only falls back to preferred_ctas[0] when cta_expected is True; new style_engine.CTA_GUIDANCE translates the internal label; writer_prompt renders guidance text.
iterations.reason: Measured: cta_expected is False (20.8% < 40%) yet a CTA was forced, and 0 of the 9 corpus posts matching the 'hiring' pattern announce a vacancy - the label is a misnomer.
iterations.tradeoff: structure 0.8333 -> 0.6667: removing the CTA left a single paragraph, so has_closing failed. Accepted - the audience gain outweighs it and the inversion was a correctness bug.

iterations.label: deterministic facts_used gate
iterations.failure: 18 measured numbers supplied, 0 cited, and the validator reported style_match 1.0 / SUCCESS - the QC could not see it.
iterations.change: validator.validate_post gained a facts_used check; added to CRITICAL_CHECKS so an evidence-free post cannot be SUCCESS.
iterations.reason: numbers_grounded is satisfied vacuously by a post containing no numbers, so on its own it scores an evidence-free post at 100%.
iterations.key_metric: detection works: facts_used False, status PARTIAL_SUCCESS, honest 0.9091 instead of a misleading 1.0
iterations.tradeoff: NET NEGATIVE on score (0.6791 -> 0.6599). The repair pass fired, cost a second LLM call (+289 tokens, +13.4 s) and produced identical text. Kept anyway because it exposed the real bug below and the honest score is worth more than the flattering one.
iterations.discovery: linkedin_writer built the repair prompt with no context=, so the facts were never shown to the repair call. It was asked to cite numbers it could not see - structurally unfixable.

iterations.label: obligate the evidence + give repair the facts
iterations.failure: Model received the facts and cited none. Prompt carried three restrictive instructions about numbers and zero obligating.
iterations.layer: PROMPT (justified only after the trace proved the data arrived)
iterations.change: writer_prompt relabels the facts block as evidence and adds ONE obligating constraint, emitted only when facts exist; the repair prompt now passes the facts as context.
iterations.reason: Prompt reconstruction was byte-exact at 3311 chars, so the model demonstrably had the numbers. With only restrictive instructions the safe move is to state none - so one counterweight was added, not a rewrite.
iterations.key_metric: factual 0.5 -> 1.0, evidence cited on the FIRST call (23 tasks, 83.0%, 81.5%), llm_calls back to 1
iterations.tradeoff: audience 0.80 -> 0.7333 and technical 0.80 -> 0.7333, both from fewer audience/technical words in this particular sample. Within run-to-run variation at n=1.
iterations.regression_result: 123 passed, 2 skipped + 43 new regression tests pass

stop_condition.reason: Both localised failures are fixed and covered by deterministic tests, cost is back to the one-LLM-call design target, and no regression exists. The remaining gaps (content keyword coverage, hook-type mismatch, single-paragraph output) are separate issues already queued in docs/feature_backlog.md; adding more prompt text for them would trade the project's core principle for small, unmeasurable gains.
